imageHeadline: Why marriage can feel wrong right after the wedding
imageSubtext: Honeymoon letdown is more common than you think—and what it means
pinTitle: Cold Feet on Your Honeymoon: Why Marriage Can Feel Wrong at First
pinDescription: Feeling disconnected or even regretful right after your wedding isn't rare. Research shows nearly half of newly married women experience a postnuptial letdown period—especially when family conflict and unmet expectations collide. Here's what's actually happening and how to navigate it without panic.

items.label: Postnuptial sadness affects nearly half of newlyweds
In-law tension can erode marital satisfaction over time
Talk about unmet needs before resentment hardens
